name: v0.7.11
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(server): live-input STT WebSocket on the audio worker by @TheAngryPit in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2167
* Add SoMark OXR-1.0 document parsing model by @bxespinozar in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2560
* Reduce CI turnaround with sharding and cheaper parity tests by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2567
* fix: keep converted metadata writable by @ykhrustalev in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2298
* fix: record converted dtype in exported configs by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2577
* Fix text-only input truncation by @Mengmj in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2552
* feat: native Nemotron 3.5 Parse MLX port by @geoHeil in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2562
* Fix ModelOpt NVFP4 AWQ checkpoint loading and input scaling by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2582
* Expose generation timings in Responses API results by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2583
* perf: make d1 and d1-omni faster and use less memory by @ykhrustalev in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2500
* Add MiniMax M3.1 Flash support  by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2580
* (feat) Add mtp to trainers by @Goekdeniz-Guelmez in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2558
* Add streamed diarized transcriptions and speaker analysis endpoints by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2600
* Bump version to 0.7.11 by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2599
* docs: list Granite Vision 4.1 and Mistral-Small-4 in model READMEs by @DineshKadiam in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2598
* Recover compaction failures and reuse chat prefixes by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2602
* Add Unlimited-OCR-2 support (page2d RoPE + DASH sparse attention) by @shuuul in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2601
* Add native LFM3 and LFM3-VL support by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2607
* Align LFM3 video and reasoning with release checkpoints by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2608
* Add LFM3-Audio support by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2609
* Add LFM3-Omni support by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2610
* Add LFM3 d1 decision models by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2611
* Add MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 and Jev support by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2606
* Fix Unlimited-OCR FP32 fusion and chunked prefill reference retention by @bearcatty in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2603
* Forward native STT prompts and task selection in the audio API by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2618
* Exclude transient request context from compaction history by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2612
* Exclude tool-call examples in reasoning from executable calls by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2613
* Recover long tool conversations and reduce cache overhead by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2617

## New Contributors
* @TheAngryPit made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2167
* @bxespinozar made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2560
* @Mengmj made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2552
* @geoHeil made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2562
* @DineshKadiam made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2598
* @bearcatty made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2603

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/compare/v0.7.10...v0.7.11
